2607.24304.title: Teacher Knows It Best: Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking and Tipping Points in Networked Langevin Dynamics AI Sycophancy
2607.24304.paper_summary: We formulate a statistical physics framework to model a networked stochastic dynamical system exhibiting bistability, driven by additive noise and social conformity. We apply this model to understand and mitigate AI-induced delusional spiraling-a phenomenon where algorithmic sycophancy from Large Language Models continuously reinforces inaccurate beliefs within a socially interacting society. By partitioning the network into a majority of regular agents and a minority of "aware" nodes (Teachers) placed at topological hubs, we use a degree-weighted mean-field approximation to reduce high-dimensional coupled Langevin equations into a single macroscopic drift equation. We provide a closed-form analytical derivation for the deterministic critical tipping time through a saddle-node bifurcation. We validate this analytical boundary using finite-size scaling and demonstrate a universal data collapse across diverse network topologies. Finally, we optimize an intervention strategy under a strict budget constraint that balances the topological footprint against driving velocity. We prove mathematically that under certain conditions, a highly concentrated, rapid intervention targeting massive hubs strictly outperforms a distributed, slow approach to rescue the network.
2607.24304.paper_summary_zh: 我們建立了一個統計物理框架，以建模一個顯示雙穩態的網絡隨機動力系統，該系統受到加性噪聲和社會順應的驅動。<lb/>我們應用這個模型來理解和減輕由人工智慧引起的妄想螺旋現象——這是一種算法諂媚從大型語言模型中不斷強化社會互動社會中不準確信念的現象。<lb/>通過將網絡劃分為大多數常規代理和少數“意識”節點（教師）放置在拓撲樞紐上，我們使用度加權的均場近似將高維耦合朗之萬方程簡化為一個單一的宏觀漂移方程。<lb/>我們通過鞍點-節點分岔提供了確定性臨界轉折時間的封閉形式解析推導。<lb/>我們使用有限尺寸縮放來驗證這個解析邊界，並展示了不同網絡拓撲之間的普遍數據崩潰。<lb/>最後，我們在嚴格的預算約束下優化了一個干預策略，該策略平衡了拓撲足跡與驅動速度。<lb/>我們數學上證明，在某些條件下，針對大型樞紐的高度集中、快速干預明顯優於分散的、緩慢的方法來拯救網絡。
